description: Piping design codes available for selection at the Class layer. Program-internal reference data; the selected value is stored per Class row in the Class_Define sheet.
notes: Typical ASME B31.3/B31.4 scope assumes ASME B16.11 for socket-welded and screwed forged fittings; use Fitting_Group End_Type (SW/TE/NPT/PT/BW), not a separate Dim_Standard column.
